Name: Bog's Witchy Farm Buildings
Author: BogWyytch
Description:
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/mkSLMm47/retro-bookcase-5.png[/img]

OKAY OKAY LISTEN. I knoooowww this has been requested for a veryyyyy long time, BUT LOOK ITS FINALLY HERE! A complete set of my boggified farm buildings! It even includes some buildings like the mill, golden clock and well that i had not yet uploaded onto nexus!

PLEASE MAKE SURE YOU DOWNLOAD CONTENT PATCHER AND GENERIC MOD CONFIG MENU

Replaces: (all with seasonal variants)
Farmhouse (all upgrades)
Coop (all upgrades)
Barn (all upgrades)
Mill
Well
Silo
Greenhouse (all upgrades)
Shed (all upgrades)
Fish Pond
Golden Clock
Horse & Horse Stable
Junimo Hut
Slime Hutch
Player Cabins (all varieties & upgrades)
Obelisks
Pet Bowls (all varieties)
Shipping Bin

See this mod, the entire Bogwood Collection and more in my new youtube series Murkwood Grove!
[youtube]hfF1DBlFluA[/youtube]

Check out [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/BogWyytch/mods]my other mods[/url] as i have been working hard to turn the entire game into my aesthetic!!![url=https://ko-fi.com/bogwyytch]

[/url]The frogs are a commission from my Kofi for Frog Sprinklers
The bat is a replacement for the Fairy Trinket that was a commission as well! 

If you would like to see updates on my mods or get notified when a mod is published join my [url=https://discord.gg/tCpM2s2wa4]Discord Server[/url]﻿
We have a great community of mod authors who are making mods as well for the goblins, witches, forest folk & ghouls. 

All my [url=https://linktr.ee/BogWytch]Social Links[/url]﻿ <---

Again thank you so much for everything. I have been blown away by all your support.
<3
Bog

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/HLCGJHRV/retro-bookcase-13.png[/img]

Gwen's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6086]Medieval SV Expanded[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7332]Way Back Pelican Town[/url] 
DaisyNiko's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]Earthy Recolor[/url] 
Aimon's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28948]Witchy Dirt and Grass[/url] 

to make the rest of the valley look great with my mods<3 As well as 

Morghoula's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12746]Enchanted Grove Farm Map[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22743]Alchemistry[/url]

(This is the combination i am using in screenshots & my own playthrough along with all my mods)
